purpose: Flagship importer tool. Computes embedded emissions (direct + indirect, tCO2e) for a consignment of CBAM goods from actual installation data or Commission default values, applying the system boundaries and monitoring rules of the Implementing Regulation. Handles precursor emissions from ART-72.
